entries.clue: Line where two pieces of cloth are joined, then pressed open flat
Pivoted blades kept for cloth alone, never lent out for paper
Lion who dies on the Stone Table in place of Edmund, then rises again
Two rows of teeth married up by a sliding tab, prone to jamming on a jacket
Velvety, flat-faced little violet, grown in beds and brought in by the bunch
Land of talking beasts, held under a spell of winter with no Christmas
Weather prediction the committee refreshes hourly, hoping for a dry Saturday
Great yellow-rayed giant the children race to grow tallest by August
New name for a worn-out cab horse once wings sprouted on him
Surname shared by four wartime evacuees who came home kings and queens
Selfish road user, and the roast of that name carved into baps with apple sauce
Dial-set tightness of thread, blamed when a machine puckers the fabric
